thread:
alex: FYI getting a PagerDuty burst for `inference-api:high-error-rate` across us-west-2. Lots of duplicates. PD is firing every ~30s. ops-bot: pagerduty incident INC2103 created by alerting-rule.
maria: I'm seeing the same in the alert stream, looks like a spike after the 03:00 deploy. errors are 5xx proxy errors (502/504).
tim_oncall: I'm on it, switching to live-mitigation mode. @maria can you drop the recent deploy hash? and @liz_sre please standby for handoff. :rotating_light:
ops-bot: deploy-event: service=inference-api user=deploy-bot commit=7a9c4d short_message="rollout v2.13"
charlie_platform: confirmed deploy 7a9c4d rolled to canary->prod around 02:58. Canary looked fine, prod traffic ramped at 03:05.
alex: customer impact: a small percentage of requests (~2%) saw increased latency then 5xx. a few high-traffic customers reported brief errors. we should assess blast radius.
maria: quick check of logs shows repeated upstream timeouts hitting router->modelpool. stack traces show retry loops causing request amplification.
liz_sre: hypothesis: new routing change in v2.13 altered client keepalive behavior and exposed a connection pool bug. Need to contain noise and avoid paging engines.
tim_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily extend dedupe window for `inference-api` PD rule from 30s -> 5m; 2) set a soft rate-limit on alerts (squelch) for non-critical error types; 3) create a short-lived dashboard for SRE/Oncall. I'll execute 1 and 2 now.
maria: +1. Also enable a temporary fallback model variant for heavy tails so requests don't hit the struggling pool.
ops-bot: alert-rule-update: rule=inference-api-high-error-rate dedupe_window=300s updated by tim_oncall
ops-bot: silenced: rule=inference-api-noncritical-errors scope=prod duration=30m by tim_oncall
charlie_platform: pushed a 30m routing fallback to model-variant `small-lr-fallback` for traffic >90th percentile.
alex: I notified Customer Success to set expectations for affected customers and to watch for support tickets.
liz_sre: team, quick note — don't change thresholds too aggressively. We'll gather metrics for 1h then revert. Aim for minimizing pages while we stabilize.
maria: collecting request traces and correlation ids, dumping into the new temp dashboard. queries: `sum by (code) (increase(http_requests_total{job="inference-api"}[5m]))` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference-api"}[5m])) by (le))`
tim_oncall: dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/temp-inference-noise (short-lived). Will link to incident.incident/INC2103.
ops-bot: incident INC2103 status=investigating assigned=tim_oncall
maria: so far after dedupe/squelch changes alerts dropped by >90% in PD, Slack thread traffic reduced. we're still collecting post-deploy regressions.
liz_sre: handoff plan: I'm taking post-incident morning shift at 09:00. tim, please capture actions into the incident ticket and handoff checklist.
tim_oncall: copied to INC2103: actions=
- revert dedupe window to 30s after stability window (60m)
- create permanent dedupe+grouping rule for router-timeout errors
- propose new alert severity for transient upstream timeouts
- instrument connection pool metrics into per-pod dashboard
- follow-up postmortem with remediation and rollout gating
- run a synthetic traffic job to validate route fallback

maria: quick note for SRE playbook: add example alert thresholds for when rollback vs squelch is appropriate. we've been defaulting to squelch too often.
charlie_platform: scheduling an infra postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 with eng-runtime, eng-platform, and customer success. I'll create the calendar invite.
alex: thanks everyone. one more thing: create a low-noise watchlist channel for the next 24h so we can monitor regressions without spamming oncall. maybe `#inference-watch` and invite the incident responders.
liz_sre: sounds good. Tim, can you then draft the post-incident alert tuning RFC? Include grouping keys, dedupe strategy, and per-region thresholds.
tim_oncall: will do. adding to INC2103 and will attach sample config: 
```
alert: inference-api-high-error-rate
expr: increase(http_requests_total{job="inference-api",code=~"5.."}[5m]) > 100
annotations:
  severity: page
group_by: [service, region]
dedupe_window: 300s   # temp; revert to 30s after stability
```
ops-bot: incident INC2103 status=stabilized updated_by=tim_oncall
maria: metrics look stable for 22m, errors trending down. will continue to monitor.
alex: handoff complete. liz take lead for the morning, tim please ping when you post the RFC. :thumbsup:
liz_sre: got it. posting brief to #postmortems after the meeting.
charlie_platform: invite sent for 10:00. tagging the relevant owners.
ops-bot: reminder in 30m: please confirm dedupe window revert timer for INC2103.
end of thread
